title: Compliance Label Assistant
subtitle: Explainable AI label review
home_summary: Turns alcohol-label images into explainable field checks with AI extraction and deterministic verification.
home_skill_1_details: A React and Vite frontend manages image queues, expected field values, field-level results, stale-result handling, and CSV or XLSX exports. Each queued label retains its own expected values.
home_skill_2_summary: FastAPI separates extraction from explainable field verification.
home_skill_2_details: Thin Python endpoints delegate upload validation, image preprocessing, provider-backed extraction, and deterministic comparison to separate modules. Pydantic models define the public API contract, while pytest covers boundary and verification behavior.
home_skill_3_summary: Vision models extract visible label fields for deterministic review.
home_skill_3_details: The backend-only OpenAI integration extracts text from validated label images. Python rules compare those fields against reviewer-provided expectations, returning statuses and reasons; the model does not make final compliance decisions.
detail_summary: Turns alcohol-label images into explainable field checks with AI extraction and deterministic verification.
problem: Reviewing label artwork against expected application values requires repeated field-by-field comparison.
solution: Separates vision-based field extraction from deterministic verification, then presents reviewable evidence and exportable results. This prototype assists human review and does not make official compliance determinations.

title: NotePal
subtitle: Co-developed AI study workspace
home_summary: Transforms study materials into structured notes, practice quizzes, and context-aware AI chat.
home_skill_1_summary: Next.js powers NotePal's web interface and routing.
home_skill_1_details: The Next.js frontend provides the application routes, authenticated study workspace, rich-text editing, quizzes, and document-aware chat. A separate Flask/Python module processes document and media inputs.
home_skill_2_summary: TypeScript gives NotePal's frontend a typed application layer.
home_skill_2_details: TypeScript supports the Next.js component and routing code that coordinates file uploads, generated notes, quizzes, session state, and content-aware chat responses.
home_skill_3_summary: OpenAI API generates NotePal's language-based study features.
home_skill_3_details: OpenAI requests generate summaries and quizzes. The chat route uses a history-aware LangChain retriever with document-scoped Pinecone embeddings to ground streamed responses in study notes.
detail_summary: Transforms study materials into structured notes, practice quizzes, and context-aware AI chat.
problem: Study material arrives in many formats, making it difficult to organize and review in one place.
solution: Co-developed by Nicolas Gioanni and Parth Gupta. Combines a Next.js study workspace with Python media-processing code, generated study tools, and retrieval-backed chat.

title: Tergion Technologies
subtitle: Business intake and CRM integrations
home_summary: Connects business inquiries and automation assessments to CRM records and confirmation emails.
home_skill_1_summary: Next.js connects the public site to a validated server-side intake route.
home_skill_1_details: The App Router site provides a four-step Quick Request and an eight-step Business Automation Assessment. Both submit to a shared lead endpoint with schema validation and server-side provider boundaries.
home_skill_2_summary: TypeScript models the forms and integration boundaries.
home_skill_2_details: Typed lead and assessment models work with Zod validation, contact resolution, submission identity, and provider-specific mapping. Tests cover request guards, duplicate handling, CRM behavior, and confirmation emails.
home_skill_3_summary: Cloudflare Workers hosts the site and protected intake workflow.
home_skill_3_details: The OpenNext adapter targets Cloudflare Workers. Turnstile verification protects production submissions, while configured Upstash Redis supports rate limiting and duplicate suppression. CRM delivery and customer email remain separate provider operations.
detail_summary: Connects business inquiries and automation assessments to CRM records and confirmation emails.
problem: Business inquiries need a consistent handoff from public forms to operational contact records.
solution: Validates intake, reserves submission identities, resolves CRM contacts, records assessment details, and sends confirmation emails. Broader marketing workflow examples remain illustrative rather than claims of implemented automation.

title: LeetNotes
subtitle: Automated LeetCode study system
home_summary: Transforms spreadsheet study notes into an automatically maintained, searchable coding-practice repository.
home_skill_1_summary: Python implements the LeetNotes synchronization CLI.
home_skill_1_details: The Python package fetches published sheet CSVs, normalizes problem titles and LeetCode metadata, generates Markdown notes, detects solution languages, writes language-specific files, and maintains an indexed problem structure.
home_skill_2_summary: GitHub Actions keeps generated study material synchronized.
home_skill_2_details: The scheduled notes.yml workflow runs the CLI, rebuilds notes and solution files from published sheet data, and commits any repository changes for review.
home_skill_3_summary: Google Sheets serves as LeetNotes' editable content source.
home_skill_3_details: Paired Notes and Solutions sheets published as CSV hold problem metadata, approaches, complexity, study notes, and source-code snippets. Language hints and detection support multiple solution languages.
detail_summary: Transforms spreadsheet study notes into an automatically maintained, searchable coding-practice repository.
problem: Daily problem-solving notes and solution files become difficult to keep consistent across spreadsheets and folders.
solution: Normalizes problem metadata, generates Markdown and Python files, and uses GitHub Actions to keep the repository synchronized on a schedule.

title: Clair
subtitle: Customizable desktop file organizer
home_summary: Organizes cluttered folders with customizable file rules, reusable presets, and a native desktop interface.
home_skill_1_details: Python 3.11 and the standard os module scan selected folders, map file extensions to JSON-defined categories, create destination folders, move files, and optionally remove empty directories.
home_skill_2_summary: Bash supports Clair's source-based development workflow.
home_skill_2_details: Shell commands create and activate the development environment, install Python requirements, and launch the application from source; Clair's sorting logic itself remains Python-based.
home_skill_3_summary: PySide6 provides Clair's cross-platform desktop interface.
home_skill_3_details: Qt for Python renders the dark-mode controls for folder selection, category and extension management, reusable presets, recursive scanning, optional cleanup, and the one-click organization workflow.
detail_summary: Organizes cluttered folders with customizable file rules, reusable presets, and a native desktop interface.
problem: Downloads and working folders quickly become difficult to navigate when files use inconsistent naming and locations.
solution: Maps extensions to editable categories, applies reusable presets, and packages the workflow as a standalone desktop application.
